lines.name: Pure roofline (peak optimum)
lines.includes: Active accelerator power × FLOPs ÷ throughput. Peak batch, peak utilization, no overhead.
lines.excludes: Excludes datacenter PUE, idle machines, host CPU/DRAM, training amortization, embodied carbon, real-world overhead.
lines.verdict: Theoretical floor — real production is always higher.

lines.name: Roofline + comprehensive stack overhead
lines.includes: Add Google's measured 1.72× factor for host CPU+DRAM, provisioned idle machines, datacenter PUE.
lines.excludes: Still excludes training amortization, embodied carbon, production-fleet inefficiencies.

lines.name: + MLPerf calibration + training + embodied
lines.includes: Add MLPerf v5.1 calibration (×1.56), training amortization (×1.20), embodied carbon (×1.08). Total bridge 3.48×.
lines.excludes: Does not include production overhead beyond MLPerf benchmark conditions.
lines.verdict: Our v4 bottom-up. Probably still too low for long-context production.

lines.name: Google fleet measurement, decomposed by prompt
lines.includes: Take Google's 0.24 Wh/median prompt. Split into fixed-per-prompt and per-token marginal cost. Apply to our prompt count and token count, scaled by model size ratio.
lines.excludes: Assumes our long-context workload follows the same per-token marginal as Google's short-prompt median. Could over-scale for long prompts.
lines.verdict: Most direct extrapolation from a published production measurement.

lines.name: Mistral LCA scaled by params
lines.includes: Mistral Large 2 published LCA (Jul 2025, ADEME-audited): 2.85 mg CO2/token. Scale linearly by active params. Adjust for training amortization base size.
lines.excludes: Mistral's number includes a single model's training amortized over only 18 months. Anthropic/Google have larger amortization bases → lower training share per token.
lines.verdict: Only published LCA for a frontier model. Upper-bound flavor.

lines.name: API spend × electricity share
lines.includes: Industry heuristic: electricity is 3-20% of provider cost. Real Gemini spend ($17,668) × elec share ÷ enterprise rate ($0.04-0.08/kWh). For Claude, use list-price equivalent (~$105K) × cost-to-list ratio (~30%).
lines.excludes: Sensitive to electricity-share assumption (5× swing between 3% and 20%). Provider margins on inference are debated.
lines.verdict: Market-based sanity check. Wide range because variables are not well-known.
